page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or onboard GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants on the host.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server is classified as a memory-optimized instance. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources, avoiding the need to provision larger, more expensive instances just to meet memory demands. Appropriate workloads include in-memory databases, caching layers, mid-sized database management systems, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
